definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named primeFibInner source-level while statement from its exact MPY constructors.
definitions.text:
rule primeFibInner
    => While(
         Compare(
           BinOp("*", Name("divisor"), Name("divisor")),
           CmpOp("<=", Name("a"))),
         If(
           Compare(
             BinOp("%", Name("a"), Name("divisor")),
             CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
           Assign(Name("is_prime"), Bool(false))
           .Stmts,
           .Stmts)
         Assign(
           Name("divisor"),
           BinOp("+", Name("divisor"), Int(1)))
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named primeFibInnerCore proof term as the corresponding internal #while loop head.
definitions.text:
rule primeFibInnerCore
    => #while(

           CmpOp("<=", Name("a"))),
         If(
           Compare(
             BinOp("%", Name("a"), Name("divisor")),
             CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
           Assign(Name("is_prime"), Bool(false))
           .Stmts,
           .Stmts)
         Assign(
           Name("divisor"),
           BinOp("+", Name("divisor"), Int(1)))
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named primeFibOuter source-level Fibonacci-search while statement.
definitions.text:
rule primeFibOuter
    => While(
         Compare(Name("count"), CmpOp("<", Name("n"))),
         Assign(
           Name("next_value"),
           BinOp("+", Name("a"), Name("b")))
         Assign(Name("a"), Name("b"))
         Assign(Name("b"), Name("next_value"))
         Assign(Name("divisor"), Int(2))
         Assign(
           Name("is_prime"),
           Compare(Name("a"), CmpOp(">=", Int(2))))
         primeFibInner
         Assign(
           Name("count"),
           BinOp("+", Name("count"), Name("is_prime")))
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named primeFibOuterCore proof term as the corresponding internal #while loop head.
definitions.text:
rule primeFibOuterCore
    => #while(

         Assign(Name("a"), Name("b"))
         Assign(Name("b"), Name("next_value"))
         Assign(Name("divisor"), Int(2))
         Assign(
           Name("is_prime"),
           Compare(Name("a"), CmpOp(">=", Int(2))))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining primeFibBody as the exact initialization, outer loop, and return constructor sequence.
definitions.text:
rule primeFibBody
    => Assign(Name("a"), Int(0))
       Assign(Name("b"), Int(1))
       Assign(Name("count"), Int(0))
       Assign(Name("next_value"), Int(0))
       Assign(Name("divisor"), Int(2))
       Assign(Name("is_prime"), Bool(false))
       primeFibOuter
       Return(Name("a"))
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Base equation of the primeScan summary: when the next divisor exceeds the square-root bound, the incoming flag is the scan result.
definitions.text:
rule primeScan(A, D, P) => P
    requires D >=Int 2 andBool D *Int D >Int A
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Divisor case of the primeScan recurrence: a divisor within the scan bound defines the result to be false.
definitions.text:
rule primeScan(A, D, _P) => false
    requires D >=Int 2
     andBool D *Int D <=Int A
     andBool pyMod(A, D) ==Int 0
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Non-divisor recurrence equation for primeScan, oriented as a fold from the next divisor state to the current named summary.
definitions.text:
rule primeScan(A, D +Int 1, P) => primeScan(A, D, P)
    requires D >=Int 2
     andBool D *Int D <=Int A
     andBool pyMod(A, D) =/=Int 0
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base equation of primeFibSearch: once the accumulated count reaches the target, the current Fibonacci value A is the result.
definitions.text:
rule primeFibSearch(N, C, A, _B) => A
    requires C >=Int N
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Inductive recurrence equation for primeFibSearch, oriented to fold the updated count and Fibonacci state back to the current summary.
definitions.text:
rule primeFibSearch(
         N,
         C +Int #if primeScan(B, 2, B >=Int 2) #then 1 #else 0 #fi,
         B,
         A +Int B)
    => primeFibSearch(N, C, A, B)
    requires N >=Int 1
     andBool C <Int N
     andBool A >=Int 0
     andBool B >=Int 1
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Additional false-flag absorption fact used for simplification; prove.sh never first proves this exact rule in a module that omits it.
source_rules.text:
rule primeScan(_A, D, false) => false
    requires D >=Int 2
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Additional one-step exit-boundary simplifier deriving result B when the next prime-bit update reaches the target; its exact statement is not separately proved without this rule.
source_rules.text:
rule primeFibSearch(N, C, _A, B) => B
    requires N >=Int 1
     andBool C <Int N
     andBool notBool (
       C +Int #if primeScan(B, 2, B >=Int 2) #then 1 #else 0 #fi
       <Int N)
     andBool B >=Int 1
    [simplification]
